title: Annotated image
responsibility: Shows a design image with region threads and controls for whole-image or region comments.

inputs.name: AnnotatedImage.src
inputs.description: Image URL set as the image element's src; the component does not validate it. A change to a nonempty value clears the drawn region and the selected thread's region, and no load-failure message is shown.

inputs.name: AnnotatedImage.title
inputs.description: Alternative text set as the image's alt attribute; the component uses it nowhere else and does not check its value.
examples: Checkout summary v003 Option 2 mobile empty

inputs.name: AnnotatedImage.caption
inputs.description: Optional text shown in a strong element in the action bar before the image; nothing is rendered when it is empty, and the default is an empty string.

inputs.name: AnnotatedImage.threads
inputs.description: Thread records; each one with a region becomes a pin labeled with its numeric pin at the region's x and y, and a thread whose region is null gets no pin. Clicking a pin highlights that region and calls select with that thread.

inputs.name: AnnotatedImage.writable
inputs.description: Enables the whole-image and keyboard-region buttons and lets a pointer drag start a selection; when false, those buttons are disabled and no drag can start, but pins stay clickable. A selection already made or a keyboard form already open is still submitted without rechecking this value.

inputs.name: AnnotatedImage.comment
inputs.description: Called with null for the whole-image action, or with a rectangle whose x, y, width and height are fractions of the image size. Pointer rectangles under 1% in width or height are discarded, keyboard width and height are capped at the space left after x and y, and errors thrown by this callback are not caught.

inputs.name: AnnotatedImage.select
inputs.description: Called only when a pin is clicked, with the thread object from threads; the component highlights that thread's region before the call. Errors thrown by this callback are not caught.

outputs.name: AnnotatedImage
outputs.description: Image viewer with a full-size toggle, thread pins, drag selection, and a keyboard form for region percentages whose defaults are x=10%, y=10%, width=40% and height=30%. A drawn region shows a Comment on selection button, and calling comment does not itself persist a comment.
